name: Riverstone Shopping Center
summary: Riverstone Shopping Center is a community retail destination located at Highway 6 and Riverstone Boulevard in affluent Missouri City, Texas. Managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust, the center serves the thriving Riverstone master-planned community with convenient access to shopping, dining, and services.
demographics: Riverstone Shopping Center serves the affluent Missouri City community south of Houston, attracting upper-middle-class families with household incomes significantly above the regional average. The primary trade area consists of young to middle-aged professionals (ages 30-55) with children, drawn from the master-planned Riverstone community and surrounding suburban neighborhoods. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to everyday necessities, dining, and services, with a preference for quality retailers that match their lifestyle expectations. The center benefits from Missouri City's diverse, educated population and strong household formation trends in this rapidly growing Fort Bend County submarket.
description: Riverstone Shopping Center is a premier community shopping destination strategically located at the southwest corner of Highway 6 and Riverstone Boulevard in Missouri City, Texas. Embedded within one of Houston's most affluent suburban communities, this well-positioned center serves the thriving Riverstone master-planned development and surrounding neighborhoods in Fort Bend County. The property is owned and managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRPLTD), a nationally recognized real estate investment trust with expertise in retail, healthcare, residential, and industrial properties. With convenient highway access and visibility along Highway 6, the center provides residents with easy access to shopping, dining, and essential services. The shopping center has earned strong community recognition with a 4.4-star rating from over 600 reviews, reflecting its role as a valued neighborhood gathering place that combines quality tenants with excellent accessibility in one of the Houston area's most desirable residential markets.
